steps.subject: sun/glow
steps.action: paint a small sun in the sky
steps.motion: small x strokes in a circle
steps.rule: straight strokes are hard to blend, x strokes are easier

steps.subject: sun/glow
steps.action: add yellow ochre around the sun edge
steps.load: touch of ochre on the brush
steps.rule: ochre gives the edge a gold color

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: crimson edges around the sun
steps.load: a small amount tapped into the bristles
steps.motion: x strokes from outside working inward
steps.rule: color lightens as it moves inward

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blue and crimson lavender along the top
steps.motion: gently throw in along the top
steps.rule: lets the color blend downward softly

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend the two sky areas together

steps.subject: sun/glow
steps.action: finger paint a soft quiet sun
steps.load: a touch of white on the finger
steps.rule: a quiet sun that is not too bright

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: peach cloud circles across the sun
steps.rule: warm peachy color suits the warm scene

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend the cloud with a dry brush
steps.rule: removes excess paint

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: sparkle light flavor on the cloud
steps.load: white with a little cad yellow and ochre
steps.motion: small sparkle dabs with the corner
steps.rule: adds a little flavor to the highlight

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: fluff the cloud with the big brush
steps.rule: just enough to add flavor on top

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: bright red highlight on a second cloud
steps.rule: checks that the cloud stands out

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: peach cloud from crimson and yellows
steps.motion: tap the peach cloud in place
steps.rule: works best one cloud at a time in layers

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: tiny highlight on the peach cloud
steps.rule: needs only a tiny bit

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: another bright red cloud
steps.rule: many clouds make the painting pastel

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: small lavender clouds lower down
steps.load: blue and crimson mix on the brush
steps.rule: color darkens away from the sun, the light source

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: tiny floaters near top and sides
steps.rule: keeps the top of the sky from being empty

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: highlight the dark clouds on top
steps.load: bright red with a little white
steps.rule: highlights separate the planes so the distance reads

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: gently blend the clouds together
steps.rule: brings all the clouds together

steps.subject: water
steps.action: pull the horizon line across
steps.rule: dilute color for a softer line than liquid clear

steps.subject: water
steps.action: add crimson to the lavender water
steps.load: crimson added to the same brush
steps.rule: gives the water a reddish lavender tone

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: lay in the basic shape of the major wave
steps.load: a little white on the fan
steps.motion: lay in a basic wave shape
steps.rule: the wave shape sets where it crashes

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: small rocking strokes for distant waves
steps.rule: suggests small waves far away

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: crash a small wave with the filbert
steps.rule: a small crash, not a big one

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: shadow under the crash
steps.load: blue crimson and black mix on the filbert
steps.motion: let it come around the crash
steps.rule: the shadow makes the crash stand out

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: highlight the crash with an upward push

steps.subject: water
steps.action: soften the edge with the corner of a 1in brush
steps.rule: gives the edge a very soft finish

steps.subject: water
steps.action: add pale green-yellow to the eye of the wave
steps.load: white with a touch of cad yellow
steps.rule: light zings through the water
steps.new: blue and yellow mix to green where they meet

steps.subject: water
steps.action: knife ripple of white
steps.rule: suggests a ripple moving in the water

steps.subject: water
steps.action: blend the knife edge back with clean fan
steps.rule: keeps the nice edge from being destroyed

steps.subject: water
steps.action: pull white down under the light source
steps.rule: a streak under the light makes the curl

steps.subject: water
steps.action: knife ripple along the reflection area
steps.rule: lets you see right through the water

steps.subject: water
steps.action: gently blend back the shiny areas
steps.rule: must not destroy the shine

steps.subject: water
steps.action: add small white lines and ripples
steps.rule: a dark line underneath separates the shapes

steps.subject: land
steps.action: block in the sand dune shapes
steps.load: brownish grey mix from the palette
steps.motion: basic shapes over the lower canvas
steps.rule: a dark base lets the lighter color show

steps.subject: land
steps.action: touch white and red roll on dune tops
steps.load: knife roll of white with a little red
steps.motion: barely graze and let it break
steps.rule: lets the lighter top color stand out

steps.subject: land
steps.action: lavender shadow dabs on the dunes
steps.rule: sparkles the dunes up

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: sea grass dabs with thinned sap green
steps.load: sap green with brown and thinner
steps.rule: thinner paint keeps the grass light

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: lift sea oats upward with thin dark sienna
steps.rule: shows sea oats growing out there

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: light tips on the sea oats
steps.rule: light tips show up against the dark

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: pull white up from the base of the grass
steps.motion: grab the bottom and pull a little
steps.rule: brings the grass together
